summary: The homogeneous change-of-bump estimate is a verbatim ℤ-indexed copy of the private inhomogeneous lemma in BesovSpace.lean, and the new cutoff finite-overlap lemma repeats the proof of the existing inhomogeneous one; both should be factored. The cutoff symbol lemmas, the ℤ window-sum lemma and the vanishing/kernel results are new and reuse existing API.
